name: dsh-mail
description: DSH plugin for agent email tools: send, mass send (CSV-personalised), send-later (scheduled queue), read/fetch inbox, list domains. Multi-provider: Lettermint, AgentMail, Resend, OVH (SMTP/IMAP), Manual SMTP+IMAP/POP, Local self-host (expert). Settings UI + sidebar tab + agent tools.

scripts.check: for f in lib/index.js lib/providers.js lib/staging.js lib/security.js lib/client.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node test/run.mjs

author: Loukas "Luca" Tzekos
